name: claw-memory
description: Claw mod: injects your SOUL.md, MEMORY.md and open tasks into every session automatically, gives Claude remember/recall/forget tools that write memory deterministically (and refuse secrets), and keeps a daily journal.

claw_dir.title: Claw folder
claw_dir.description: Folder with SOUL.md, MEMORY.md and TASKS.md. Use the same folder for every Claw mod.

inject.title: Memory injection
inject.description: always: full memory on the first prompt, matching lines after that. first-prompt: only the first prompt. off: never.

auto_journal.title: Auto journal
auto_journal.description: Append a one-line entry to journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md after each turn.
